dedupe_keys.name: dataset and traffic flow simulation in wide road network to evaluate bridges in flooding events registered in the alessandria region

description: Dataset and Traffic Flow Simulation in Wide Road Network to Evaluate Bridges in Flooding Events Registered in the Alessandria Region is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Amirehsan Charlang Bakhtyari, Francesco Deflorio (Politecnico di Torino). This dataset supports a study, which proposes a scalable methodology to evaluate the vulnerability of road networks to flood-induced disruptions. The methodology combines publicly available geospatial data, flood hazard maps, and macroscopic traffic simulation using SUMO (Simulation of Urban Mobility) to assess the network-wide impact of bridge closures. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
